This class does not deserve even half a star. I strongly advise anyone who wants to learn English not to join this class at all. It will not only waste your money but also your valuable time.
I am sharing my experience. Many of us who are already working in good organizations and are at decent positions join such classes only to improve our communication skills. We clearly mention that we cannot give long periods of time like 4–6 months. Initially, the counselor asks you to visit the class and conducts a very basic assessment by asking the same general questions to everyone to judge their English level. Based on that, they claim to place students in levels like basic, intermediate, or advanced. But let me tell you—they put everyone in the basic level.
They ask you to pay the fees within a week, but they do not teach anything worthwhile. You gain absolutely nothing from the class. I have seen many students, college students as well as working professionals—who enrolled with genuine hopes. Some students came from poor backgrounds to improve themselves and get better jobs. Others joined to improve communication so they could perform better in meetings. Unfortunately, this so-called class only used their money and never actually taught anything.
The teacher herself lacks proper mannerisms and communication skills. Most of the time, she talks only about herself and her so-called achievements, which I personally found meaningless. If you cannot understand where your students are coming from, remain busy on your phone, and focus on makeup instead of teaching, then why are you there—just to loot people’s money?
I paid ₹11,000 and left the class in less than 10 days because I found absolutely no value in it. As a working woman, attending a class that is neither involved nor concerned about students problems felt like a complete waste of time. I was only going there and returning disappointed every day.
I even suggested this class to someone I know, but she too left within two weeks, saying the same thing that the teacher teaches nothing and keeps repeating the same grammar topic for weeks. I personally witnessed many students who were new to the city for job purposes joining this class with the dream of speaking fluent English in a few months so they can get good jobs, but it turned out to be a complete waste.
They have looted many people and are still doing so. They force students to give reviews in front of them, asking for 4–5 stars and praise. That is why you see very few negative reviews online. I too joined this class after seeing good reviews, but please do not fall for them.
If you want to learn English quickly and do not want to waste your hard-earned money, do not join this class. Do not!!
